author: PoopingAsIBrowse
body: A lot of events are Key negative in boss mode, this one definitely is. Hard+horde makes you bleed keys so it's best to not do both at the same time unless you have a comfortable stock pile. Hard ensures better "end dungeon" reward quality where as horde gets you more chances of dungeons drops so it's better to trade off than to combine unless you are rolling in keys. Good luck!

author: Enough-Bike7525
body:
I'm always running low on keys so I feel ya.

Here's what I do though:

Horde mode on normal in any themed dungeon (except Goblin's Fortress/Chaos Portal/Valley of the Gods). If horde mode on Battlegrounds or Balor Portal is too tough, then just skip it due to the 5 key entry cost.

Costs 1 key to horde mode Mystic Cave and 2 to horde mode Dragon's Roost--doing either of those will net you many more keys than it costs to join.

The 1 key cost for Beast Cave is nice but it isn't too often you'll find keys in there so up to you on whether you wanna do that one or not.

Boss mode normal dungeons will sometimes net you more keys than it costs; at the most, you'll usually break even or fall a key short.

If you have more time on your hands, endless is a good idea but that dungeon cooldown after you do endless is rough.

All in all, sometimes ya have to steer clear of doing dungeons on hard mode in order to get your key supply up. I feel ya there, too, cause I love doing hard mode dungeons for those juicy rewards at the end.

Party play is also an option for farming keys, but that requires coordination which can be tough to pull off at times.

Don't forget to do a little bit of DMG to kingdom raids, like Last Titan, Malor, and Starlord cause they drop keys as well.

Oh, and t8 boss dungeons used to be my go to as well for keys, but since they changed it so Enlightened Prince doesn't drop gauntlet keys anymore, it's not really worth the time.

Good luck on your quest for keys!

author: VanZandtVS
body:
Party runs is the answer at t10, but if you're dead set on not finding a group then all you can really do is just maximize the number of keys you're farming in between key-intensive events. 

Farm world bosses on trips around town as a passenger and run plenty of normal non-boss dungeons for Summoning Scrolls and keys.

author: SliceNSpice69
body: Just need to run boss dungeons with one other person. It’s the easiest way imo. 4x the cost compared to solo, but 2x the runs, and 4x the bosses per level because it becomes horde + boss. Better gains with more players in the party, but just one other person and some regular dungeons will do it.
